name: Alfa Romeo P3
description:
Alfa Romeo Tipo B Monoposto 'P3' - 1935, 3.8 litre

8 cyl in-line 78 * 100 mm = 3822 cc, 2 valves/cyl, Roots supercharger, 330 bhp
3 speed gearbox in unit with engine
Front: independent Dubonnet system with trailing links
Rear: reversed quarter elliptic leaf springs

Jano's 1932 Tipo B, kept in the fight against the German cars by one engine enlargement after another - 2.6, then 2.9, then 3.2 and finally this 3822 cc unit, the same engine that went into the 8C-35. It was the 3.2 litre car that Nuvolari drove to his celebrated 1935 German Grand Prix win at the Nurburgring, beating the far more powerful Mercedes W25s in front of 300,000 stunned spectators.
author: Legion
